setting: [Setting: the Jade Hotel back stairwell, green tile walls, a brass fire-hose cabinet with a glass door, a flight of stairs down.]
extra: MARLO QUILL (<IMAGE_2>), a teal tape measure around his neck; a BELLHOP THUG (green bellhop uniform).
camera: Single shot: handheld, the camera close behind the thug, strikes travel toward the lens
eyeline_sentence: Eyelines: everyone looks at each other and the props in front of them, never into the lens; faces in profile or three-quarter.

beats.text: At 1 s, the THUG throws a straight right punch at MARLO's head; MARLO tilts aside like balancing a tray and the punch lands in the fire-hose cabinet door, cracking its glass panel.
At 4 s, MARLO's palm shove lands on the thug's shoulder; the thug spins half around and grabs the rail.
At 7 s, MARLO hooks the tape measure around the thug's ankle and tugs; the thug sits down hard on the top step and slides down three stairs on his backside.
